history.summary: UNVERIFIED - no published history found for this temple. Gopal Ji Temple is a local Krishna (Gopal Ji) shrine at Kakaganj, Sagar (listing address RPHM+4WX, Kakaganj, Sagar, MP 470002; rated 4.5/29 reviews). It appears in MP travel guides among Sagar's temples (Gulab Baba Mandir, Mangalgiri Mandir, Jwala Mata Mandir) but no founding date, patron or builder is recorded online. Do not confuse with the Gopal Mandir (Dwarkadhish) in Ujjain.

town_description: Sagar is a historic city in Madhya Pradesh on the NH-44 corridor, set around Sagar Lake. It is home to Dr. Hari Singh Gour University and serves as a regional trade and education centre for Bundelkhand. Nearby attractions include the Gupta-era archaeological site of Eran and the Makronia dargah with Osho Hill.

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport is Bhopal (Raja Bhoj), ~170 km (verify). Dhana airstrip near Sagar has no commercial flights.
travel.railway: Sagar Junction (SGO) is the main station, ~3 km from Kakaganj (verify).
travel.road: Sagar is on NH-44; the temple at Kakaganj is in the city, reachable by auto-rickshaw/taxi.
